name: 00_Cerebrum
notes: The vault machinery with no corpus: the operating manual, WHY.md, the OKF v0.2 spec, the knowledge-base template, three skills and 37 scripts. Build 21: the viewer's helper offers Claude Sonnet 5.5, and viewer-check.js keeps a running helper out of its Settings geometry checks, which a late answer from it could fail. Build 19 ships the launcher, Open 00_Cerebrum.command, which the viewer already pointed to, and an icon for it drawn from the viewer's mark on a demo vault, so _scripts/set-icon.sh works; build 17 shipped the script without either. Build 17: the concept list groups by knowledge base; Settings shows the Claude app's scheduled tasks; the viewer takes its view and search from its address; a small knowledge base gets a minimum radius on the map; verify.py gains three gauges (content stranded after the footnotes, descriptions behind their sources, source stamps older than the file they cite) and a check of each Raw register; meetings.py reads meeting notes without their transcripts; frozen knowledge bases are left out of the plural runs; and a vault-scoped report can be given a home with VAULT_REPORT_KB. Build 11 brought the 3D view. Unpack it, run python3 _scripts/verify.py, and add a knowledge base from _KB_CLAUDE_TEMPLATE.md.
